name: Inventory Report - Stock Mutation Detail
query:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(sle.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Date',
    sle.voucher_type AS "Voucher Type:Data:150",

    -- Link dinamis
    sle.voucher_no AS "Voucher No:Dynamic Link/voucher_type:200",
    
    -- Kuantitas Masuk/Keluar
    IF(sle.actual_qty > 0, sle.actual_qty, 0) AS "In Qty:Float:120",
    IF(sle.actual_qty < 0, sle.actual_qty, 0) AS "Out Qty:Float:120", 
    
    -- === MENGAMBIL LANGSUNG DARI FIELD (SESUAI ASUMSI) ===
    sle.incoming_rate AS "Incoming Rate:Float:150",
    sle.outgoing_rate AS "Outgoing Rate:Float:150",
    sle.valuation_rate AS "Valuation Rate:Float:150",
    
    -- === SALDO AKHIR ===
    sle.qty_after_transaction AS "Balance Qty:Float:140",
    sle.stock_value AS "Balance Value:Float:160"
    
FROM
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` AS sle
WHERE
    -- 3 Filter yang Anda butuhkan
    sle.item_code = %(item)s
    AND sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    
ORDER BY
    -- Wajib urut kronologis untuk kartu stok
    sle.posting_date ASC, 
    sle.posting_time ASC,
    sle.name ASC
